name: Undercover Lover
source:
About to embark on your first undercover operation, you head out for one last night of fun. Little did you know that this fun would later complicate matters.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
第一次臥底行動即將開始，你決定先出去痛痛快快玩上最後一晚。當時你哪會想到，這一晚的快活，日後會給行動添那麼多麻煩。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
